title: The production preflightSpawnFn closure has no test at any tier: the new `r.std…
description:
The production preflightSpawnFn closure has no test at any tier: the new `r.stderr instanceof Buffer` decode is proved only by a grep file-assert (AC2), and every unit test injects a fake spawn that returns plain strings, so no test would catch a wrong property name or a broken decode at the real Bun.spawnSync boundary. Risk is low here (it is a one-line mirror of the adjacent stdout guard at :2642, the required `stderr: string` return type is typecheck-enforced, and Bun docs confirm SyncSubprocess.stderr is `Buffer | undefined`), and the pre-existing stdout decode is equally untested, so this diff does not introduce the gap. Worth a follow-up integration test that really spawns a command writing to stderr and asserts the decoded string.

Source: cam/issue-363
